integration_issues.issue: sales-recap.tsx initializes `date` with `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` which is UTC. Backend uses Asia/Jakarta (+07) for sale.date / register_closes.date. During UTC evening (after 17:00 UTC = midnight+ Jakarta) the UI defaults to the previous day and shows Rp 0 even though backend has data under tz-today. Verified: date 2026-10-11 (UTC today) returned omzet=0; next-button to 2026-10-12 (Jakarta today) returned omzet=Rp 673.000, 36 trx, -Rp 1.873.000 selisih. Recommend using local date (e.g., `new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' })`) or asking backend for its today().
